name: Metethoheptazine
summary: Metethoheptazine (WY-535) is an opioid analgesic from the phenazepine family. It was invented in the 1960s.

pharmacology.text: Metethoheptazine produces similar effects to other opioids, including analgesia, sedation, dizziness and nausea.

uses.en: It was developed as a painkiller in the 1960s and has no current medical use.
uses.zh: 它在1960年代作為止痛藥開發，目前沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它在1960年代作为止痛药开发，目前没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Like other opioids it causes sedation, dizziness and nausea, and it can slow breathing, which can be dangerous. Regular use can lead to dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 和其他鴉片類一樣，它會引起鎮靜、頭暈與噁心，也可能使呼吸減慢，可能有危險。經常使用可能導致依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 和其他鸦片类一样，它会引起镇静、头晕与恶心，也可能使呼吸减慢，可能有危险。经常使用可能导致依赖。

fact.en: It belongs to the phenazepane family of opioids, built on a seven-membered nitrogen ring, a stretched version of the six-membered ring in pethidine.
fact.zh: 它屬於苯基氮雜環庚烷類鴉片，以含氮七元環為骨架，相當於把配西汀的六元環撐大一號。
fact.zhHans: 它属于苯基氮杂环庚烷类鸦片，以含氮七元环为骨架，相当于把配西汀的六元环撑大一号。
